# What the stated laws of one step miss

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> The stated laws of one step miss two laws: something taken has a taker, and nothing is taken beyond what stood with what was given.

`one-step-missing-laws` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01

Editable record: [one-step-missing-laws.json](one-step-missing-laws.json) · [Register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

Documentary review UTC: `2026-10-16T18:25:05+00:00`. Run the registry checker for source drift; this page is not a fresh proof receipt.

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Something taken from a family has a relatum taking it: the sign of the uptake is at most the count of takers (Flow.sign_uptake_le_takers). Across a step at which a family runs down, something is taken from it exactly when its total falls (Flow.RunsDownOn.taken_iff). At a condition balanced across a step, nothing is taken beyond what stood before with what was given (Flow.BalancesOn.taken_le). For a family running down closed across the step, the laws as stated in Locality (balance at each member, the fall by the takers, some standing changing and something exchanging exactly when the total falls) with the law that something taken has a taker are the whole law (OneStep.runsDownClosed_iff_stated); without it they allow a condition taken from and given to alike, passed through with nothing taking from it, which no world shows (OneStep.stated_not_realized). At one balanced condition, its level before, what is taken and given, and whether it comes or ceases to stand are shown together exactly where nothing is taken beyond what stood with what was given and coming and ceasing are as Flow.BalancesOn.comesToStand_iff and Flow.BalancesOn.ceasesToStand_iff fix them (OneStep.standing_iff); the readings alone allow more taken than there was (OneStep.standing_bound_needed). No premise.

Canonical source: [OneStep.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OneStep.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- No premise.

P79 (work board), as above: the proof of completeness found two laws missing from those stated of one step. Reading (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): that something taken has a taker, and that nothing is taken beyond what stood with what was given, belong to the laws of one step, and were before only implicit in the definitions. See the integration document §103.
